ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Осуждать» (osuzhdat') is 'condemn' throughout, distinct from «судить» (sudit', 'judge') in the river passage; «добрый… злой» (dobryy… zloy) are 'good… evil'. In Epictetus «благо» (blago) is 'the greatest good', «жить разумно» (zhit' razumno) 'to live reasonably', and the incredulous «неужто» (neuzhto, 'can it be') keeps its exclamation mark.

Source observation: [6] «Если ты так счастлив, что всегда говорить только то, что есть…»: the infinitive «говорить» breaks the series of finite verbs (отвергаешь, сомневаешься, желаешь) and looks like a transcription error for «говоришь» ('you say'); translated in the evident sense ('you always say').
